issues.display_title: Issue #1921: Update GoThru SSO Login Callback Screen UI & Experience
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Redesign the SSO login callback screen to provide a smoother, more informative sign-in experience matching the updated GoThru SSO design.

What's Changed

1. Clear Sign-In Progress

  • Added a modern sign-in card featuring the GoThru logo and animated loading indicator.
  • Shows step-by-step progress checkpoints so users know what's happening:
    • GoThru account verified
    • Villume session created
    • Profile loaded

2. Personalized "Welcome Back" Screen

  • Shows a "Welcome back, {Name}" confirmation with celebration visuals once sign-in completes.
  • Automatically transitions and redirects users to their gallery or target page.

3. Clear Error State

  • Displays an intuitive error view with clear guidance and action buttons (Try again & Back to home) if sign-in fails.

4. Visual Polish

  • Clean, modern layout matching the design prototype.
  • Fully responsive across desktop and mobile, with support for dark mode.
